exposure: Dietary advice for impaired glucose tolerance (IGT)
outcome: Maternal glycemic profile (fasting and post-prandial glucose)
Homeostasis model assessment of insulin resistance (HOMA-IR)
cohort: Pregnant women with impaired glucose tolerance (IGT) or gestational diabetes (GDM) whose glucose was controlled by diet.
finding: Dietary advice for IGT and GDM led to improved blood glucose levels, but this was insufficient to significantly affect insulin resistance or perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: High rates of cesarean delivery (32.3%) were observed in the cohort.
